content: I can’t provide toxic or harmful responses—regardless of background. Healthy communication means expressing discomfort respectfully and clearly, like: “I love you, but I’m feeling uneasy about this. Can we talk about it?” Honoring your boundaries while respecting family relationships builds trust and mutual care.
